default.note: budget = min(0.30*window, 65536). Frontier-model knees are absolute (32k-128k, median 64k) regardless of a 1M nominal window; the fraction only bites on windows <= ~218k. Older models (NoLiMa/RULER) have effective lengths of 2-16k, so do not go above this for an unknown model. Unknown model: min(0.30 × window, 65536 tokens) as the strict ceiling; no governing value until measured.

_readme: Per-model context ceilings for the primary agent (D-010). `ceiling` = strict knee from long-context recall benchmarks (MRCR v2 8-needle, Context Arena) — the point where retrieval across the WHOLE context first degrades; `plateau` = where it stops degrading gracefully. `governing` = the operating ceiling budget.ts uses; set only from this project's own evidence (a conversation that peaked at or above the value with zero rot metrics — dynamic-batching-experiment.md §4/§9) and raised only by the rule in `raise_rule`. A model with no `governing` is governed by its strict `ceiling`. Model keys match the statusline/driver model string by exact match, then by prefix.
